metadata.question: Did the cropland around the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine apprear browner between June 3 and July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (primary) for two windows centered on 2023-06-03 and 2023-07-19 within a 12 km corridor along the North Crimean Canal (Nova Kakhovka to Dzhankoi). If empty, expand windows and fallback to Landsat 8/9 L2. Restrict analysis to cropland using ESA WorldCover 2021.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds for Sentinel-2 using QA60 (clouds and cirrus) and for Landsat using QA_PIXEL (cloud, cirrus, cloud shadow, snow). Compute median NDVI composites.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Count total cropland pixels at 1 km and valid NDVI pixels post-mask. If collection empty → C1. If valid pixels = 0 → C2. If NDVI is null/NaN or outside [-0.2, 1.0] → C3. Otherwise compare NDVI; a decrease > 0.03 indicates “browner”.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObject.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function buildAOI() {
  // Approximate North Crimean Canal: Nova Kakhovka -> Armyansk -> Dzhankoi
  const line = ee.Geometry.LineString([
    [33.35, 46.78],   // Nova Kakhovka vicinity
    [33.69, 46.11],   // Armyansk vicinity
    [34.40, 45.71]    // Dzhankoi vicinity
  ]);
  return line.buffer(12000); // 12 km corridor around the canal
}

function getCroplandMask() {
  // ESA WorldCover 2021, cropland class = 40
  const wc = ee.Image('ESA/WorldCover/v200/2021').select('Map');
  const crop = wc.eq(40).selfMask();
  return crop;
}

function maskS2(img) {
  const qa = img.select('QA60');
  const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0);
  const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0);
  const mask = cloud.or(cirrus).not();
  return img.updateMask(mask).toFloat();
}

function addNdviS2(img) {
  const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
  return img.addBands(ndvi);
}

function maskLandsat(img) {
  // Landsat C2 L2 QA_PIXEL: bits 2 (cirrus), 3 (cloud), 4 (cloud shadow), 5 (snow)
  const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
  const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))
    .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));
  return img.updateMask(mask);
}

function scaleLandsatSR(img) {
  const optical = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
                     .multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2);
  return img.addBands(optical, null, true).toFloat();
}

function addNdviLandsat(img) {
  const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI');
  return img.addBands(ndvi);
}

function getS2Collection(start, end, aoi) {
  return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
    .filterBounds(aoi)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 60))
    .map(maskS2)
    .map(addNdviS2);
}

function getLandsatCollection(start, end, aoi) {
  const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
    .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end)
    .map(maskLandsat).map(scaleLandsatSR).map(addNdviLandsat);
  const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
    .filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end)
    .map(maskLandsat).map(scaleLandsatSR).map(addNdviLandsat);
  return l8.merge(l9);
}

async function getCompositeForDate(centerDateStr, aoi, cropMask) {
  // Try a sequence of sensor and window sizes
  const attempts = [
    {sensor: 'S2', days: 7},
    {sensor: 'S2', days: 14},
    {sensor: 'Landsat', days: 14},
    {sensor: 'S2', days: 21},
    {sensor: 'Landsat', days: 21}
  ];
  for (const att of attempts) {
    const days = att.days;
    const start = ee.Date(centerDateStr).advance(-days, 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(centerDateStr).advance(days, 'day').advance(1, 'day');
    let col = (att.sensor === 'S2') ? getS2Collection(start, end, aoi) : getLandsatCollection(start, end, aoi);
    const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      continue; // try next attempt
    }
    // Build median NDVI composite, apply cropland mask
    const ndviComp = col.select('NDVI').median().updateMask(cropMask).clip(aoi);
    // Prepare meta info
    const startStr = await getInfoAsync(start.format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const endStr = await getInfoAsync(end.format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    return {img: ndviComp, size, sensor: att.sensor, days, startStr, endStr};
  }
  return null; // No images found in any attempt
}

async function summarizeComposite(label, comp, aoi, cropMask, scale) {
  const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).updateMask(cropMask).clip(aoi);
  const total = await getInfoAsync(ones.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('constant'));
  const valid = await getInfoAsync(comp.img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('NDVI'));
  const mean = await getInfoAsync(comp.img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: aoi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).get('NDVI'));
  const validPx = valid || 0;
  const totalPx = total || 0;
  const pct = (totalPx > 0) ? (100.0 * validPx / totalPx) : 0;
  return {
    label,
    mean,
    validPx,
    totalPx,
    pct,
    sensor: comp.sensor,
    imgs: comp.size,
    window: `±${comp.days}`,
    range: `${comp.startStr} to ${comp.endStr}`
  };
}

function isInvalidNdvi(val) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return true;
  if (Number.isNaN(val)) return true;
  if (val < -0.2 || val > 1.0) return true;
  return false;
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const aoi = buildAOI();
    const cropMask = getCroplandMask();
    const scale = 1000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const juneDate = '2023-06-03';
    const julyDate = '2023-07-19';

    const compJune = await getCompositeForDate(juneDate, aoi, cropMask);
    const compJuly = await getCompositeForDate(julyDate, aoi, cropMask);

    if (!compJune || !compJuly) {
      console.log(`Collections: Jun3=${compJune ? compJune.imgs : 0}, Jul19=${compJuly ? compJuly.imgs : 0}`);
      console.log('At least one window has no images after attempts.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: pixel counts to detect C2
    const sumJune = await summarizeComposite('Jun3', compJune, aoi, cropMask, scale);
    const sumJuly = await summarizeComposite('Jul19', compJuly, aoi, cropMask, scale);

    // Print concise stats
    console.log(`AOI Cropland Pixels (1km): ${sumJune.totalPx}`);
    console.log(`Jun3 ${sumJune.window} ${sumJune.sensor}: Images=${sumJune.imgs}, Valid=${sumJune.validPx}/${sumJune.totalPx} (${sumJune.pct.toFixed(1)}%), NDVI=${(sumJune.mean !== null ? sumJune.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null')}`);
    console.log(`Jul19 ${sumJuly.window} ${sumJuly.sensor}: Images=${sumJuly.imgs}, Valid=${sumJuly.validPx}/${sumJuly.totalPx} (${sumJuly.pct.toFixed(1)}%), NDVI=${(sumJuly.mean !== null ? sumJuly.mean.toFixed(3) : 'null')}`);

    if (sumJune.totalPx === 0 || sumJuly.totalPx === 0 || sumJune.validPx === 0 || sumJuly.validPx === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in at least one window.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const ndviJune = sumJune.mean;
    const ndviJuly = sumJuly.mean;

    if (isInvalidNdvi(ndviJune) || isInvalidNdvi(ndviJuly)) {
      console.log(`Invalid NDVI: Jun=${ndviJune}, Jul=${ndviJuly}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = ndviJuly - ndviJune;
    console.log(`Delta NDVI (Jul - Jun): ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const threshold = -0.03; // decrease by >0.03 considered browner
    if (delta < threshold) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
